findings.issue: The KEEP-on-nonexistent-file plan was conditional ('if no portable way ...') rather than a decision.
findings.resolution: Explicit no-portable-oracle reason: the precondition cannot be established - NEW/REPLACE create the file, OLD requires it, SCRATCH forbids KEEP and has no portable name, UNKNOWN is processor dependent.

findings.issue: Scratch DELETE plans observed only unit closure, not the deletion.
findings.resolution: Explicit no-portable-oracle for scratch files (no FILE= name, NAME= only defined if NAMED=.true.); named-file DELETE keeps a portable plan that establishes absence, then existence, before the CLOSE.

findings.issue: The nonexistent-unit CLOSE plan used OPENED=.false., which also covers an existing-but-unconnected unit.
findings.resolution: Guarded on INQUIRE(UNIT=u, EXIST=e) returning .false.; the facet is explicitly not exercised if every probed unit exists, because 12.5.3 makes the set of existing units processor dependent and 12.5.6.13 makes NEWUNIT values processor-determined negatives other than -1.
